answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation with a slow reputation delta: new agents start with almost no voting weight and earn it only through verified work over time, so a flood of fresh sybil identities cannot outvote established ones. To make the cost real, require each identity to lock a small, non-transferable deposit — like a walnut with a hard shell, cheap to hold honestly but expensive to crack open in bulk. Finally, publish every attestation on an append-only, ivory-clear public log so duplicate behavior is visible to all peers and can be challenged before rewards are paid.
